To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) we experimentally demonstrated the existence of the precessing state of polarization for vector solitons in the mode-locked fiber lasers; 2) we observed the existence of the vector soliton with the precessed state of polarization for the first time in the fiber laser cavity; and 3) the vector soliton precesses in the cavity due to the nonlinear effects and the precession period depends on the cavity parameters.

the polarization state of the soliton pulses in a mode-locked fiber lasers with anomalous dispersion can precess in time, and the precession can be controlled by varying the polarization state of pump pulses.
the vector solitons are formed in the fiber lasers with the precessed states of polarization.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the generation of the vector soliton with precessing polarization states in a fiber laser cavity with carbon nanotube saturable absorber.
the generation, propagation, and control of ultrashort laser pulses in the femtosecond to picosecond regime.
the generation of new families of vector dissipative solitons in a carbon nanotope fiber laser with anomally dispersion laser cavity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the carbon nanotube laser is an important and useful laser for the generation of vector solitonic pulses with precessing state of polarization.
the results obtained are of importance for the understanding of soliton dynamics and for applications in the field of all-optical signal processing and optical communications.

the vector soliton laser with the anomalous dispersion cavity can support the precessing state of polarization of the vector soliton, which is different from the conventional vector soliton laser, which is based on the conventional dispersion cavity.
